page.overview:
Who is Aaron Davis?

Aaron Davis was embroiled in a black market arms deal, purchasing hybrid tech weapons from Herman Schultz and Jackson Brice when the meeting was interrupted by Spider-Man. Spider-Man later tracked down Davis to obtain information regarding where he could find the supplier, Adrian Toomes, and his gang.

In the years following this, Aaron expanded his own costumed identity as the Prowler. He eventually found himself displaced from his home universe, before being captured by Spider Society members Spider-Punk and Spider-Woman and detained in Earth-928B. While visiting the base, the Miles Morales of Earth-1610B exchanged greetings with him. Miles stared at him, as he was still grieving the loss of his own Uncle Aaron, prompting Prowler to call him rude for staring at him too long. He later joined with the rest of the captured villains as they cheered for Miles when he escaped the facility and boo at the Spider Society chasing him down.
